notes: Coverage: I opened the whole image once for layout, then supplied half_a once and half_b once in that order. I read every text block, word ending, accent, punctuation mark, insertion/deletion, and every inline/display formula against BOTH witnesses, including their agreements. The cancelled final block was read in full. Only the nine listed unresolved loci received enlarged crops; each crop was inspected once. Half-settled differences are explicitly identified in changes so the main reader can make its adjudication crops.

Scope and independence: only the supplied scan006 packet, conventions, notation snapshot, whole image and two halves were read. No other scan, other reader return, records directory, OCR, text-recognition process, PDF text layer, external source or delegation was used. All images generated here are ordinary PIL crops/enlargements of the supplied scan.

The first recorded UTC time is the packet-read timestamp after the brief had been read. Viewed timestamps are logged immediately before the corresponding image-tool calls; creation/view timestamps for every crop are retained. These are actual clock readings, not estimated durations.

C doubts audit: the F underletter, old le, old est, detached high marks, and old dans remain with C’s same doubt. The punctuation after somme) resolves to comma. The top mark’s 5 is demoted behind no securely readable numeral. For the second K upper degree the doubt is changed to include ordinary 1 with preceding-line collision as first possibility. The lower cancelled digits remain separate. All eight doubtful textual loci are in changes.

The non-doubt C alerts were also checked: lower tensor-AUC Hom labels, lone upper S on the second Hom, single ordinary H/K impressions, raised K degrees, low H indices and complex dots, dotted i, AUC order, comma after que, plain i in chaines, and the live obligerai- fragment. The supplied page alone was not extended by consulting any following image.

The page is a typescript with several pen additions/corrections and a pencil archive number. Nothing in this single-page packet independently establishes the writer’s personal identity, so handwriting is labelled unnamed. Typed avec and the typed phrase avec l’opération de somme retain typed origin even though their attachment hooks are handwritten.

There is no heading, date, salutation, signature, independent diagram, non-diagram drawing or readable total-page count on this sheet. The opening Hom expression is a displayed formula with a connecting arrow. Insertion connectors are represented by inserted at their attachments. The cancellation strokes of the final block are state marks, not a separate drawing.

The opening sentence calls the displayed Hom map an isomorphisme de catégories. The following paragraph says that the construction and verification of all compatibilities are not made explicit because of their length. These are source statements, not checks performed by this reader.

The page names K^0 and K^1 for the enveloping category’s invariants and states the projective-module example. It then says the same result is sans doute valid for every additive category. The comma after somme) is retained despite capital Cela, and the comma in Signalons seulement que, cette is likewise retained. No grammatical or mathematical repair was made.

The page describes the failure of strictness as making a canonical chain-complex construction seem unlikely, and invokes la théorie de Deligne in its own argument. The last live paragraph asks for a higher geometric interpretation and uses Il y a tout lieu de croire. These tentative forms were preserved, not strengthened.

The final live word remains obligerai- and the cancelled block ends néces-. No unseen continuation was supplied. Ordinary line-end splits wholly recoverable on this page, including inversible, compatibilités, respectivement, projectifs, satisfaisant and homotopiques, were joined.

H’s page{5} already represents the matching page/archive metadata, so it is not counted as an archive-number omission. Generic H macro conversions for emphasis, insertion and deletion were not counted as reading differences. Its prose note credits the cancellation of the final block, but does not supply the older overwritten dans.

No mathematical proof check, independent re-proof, computation, formal certificate or theorem re-use was performed. The potential collision between a pi_1 subscript and K upper degree is a visual layout observation only. math_checks is therefore empty.
Final file validation checked JSON schema fields, crop-file existence, and balanced TeX braces. This was a file-structure check, not a mathematical event.
